ctx.x: Well, they had some jazz musicians here, too.

Oh, there's great ones here. You had them down there, but, see, they were like second city or third city or whatever you wanted to call it. But they respected Chicago because they would sit there and listen and every -- ape and everything, because you had Louis Armstrong, Earl Hines and you had all kinds of great musicians.
